summary: SDR Drone, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing two legacy administrative orders from its prior identity as Hallmark Venture Group, Inc.: a California Desist and Refrain Order dated November 25, 2014, and a South Carolina Consent Order dated July 27, 2018 tied to former officer Robert L. Cashman, who has had no company role since 2020. No price, stake, or transaction terms are stated. The filing addresses potential effects on the company's pending Regulation A offering; no advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is disclosed. Watch regulatory disclosure risk to the offering rather than deal arbitrage.
